sentences.en: Existing legislation does not take diversity of races into account.
sentences.zh: 现有的法律没有考虑到种族多样性。

sentences.en: The world is not going to be saved by legislation.
sentences.zh: 世界不会靠立法来拯救。

sentences.en: Our surveys indicate that the public would support the proposed legislation.
sentences.zh: 我们的调查表明公众会支持这项提议的立法。

phrases.zh: 提议的立法：即将提出的法案
